name: Anstruth
description: A being or outcome altered by the object, which Haliya fears applies to her.

timeline.summary: Vondam suspects the event of his survival was engineered and that he is an anstruth.

pages_say.description: A blasphemy against reality: an event made inevitable by engineering, which Vondam fears applies to him.
